full.description: This image is a gross pathology photograph showing bisected sections of a vertebral column. The specimen displays the trabecular bone of the vertebral bodies along with intervening intervertebral discs. A distinct metastatic lesion is visible as a pale, yellowish-white mass within the bone marrow of one of the vertebral bodies. The appearance is consistent with bone metastasis from a primary tumor such as lung adenocarcinoma.

random.description: This image shows a gross specimen of a sectioned spine with several vertebrae. The cut surface reveals a pale, yellowish focal lesion within one of the vertebral bodies, surrounded by red bone marrow. This macroscopic appearance suggests a focal pathological process, such as metastatic infiltration, infection, or a primary bone lesion.
